Places

The named places of the world of ether, as the briefings, dialogues and map labels give them. The plots are on The story of Etherlords and The story of Etherlords II.

The Temple of Time

The Temple of Time stands at the edge of the world. It is the seat of the White Lord and the goal of every Lord in a Time of Changes; the first to enter it is said to become the new White Lord. In the first game the road to it opens only once a rival race is beaten, and only a Lord may take the last step inside. In Etherlords II the White Lord's castle and his Portal to the Outer Plane stand on the northern peninsula. See The White Lord.

Places of Etherlords

PlaceWhat it is
Lost CityChebokkiana, the ancient capital of the Vitals, buried by a forbidden ritual when the Synthets attacked it. In the ruins of its town centre lies the Key to the Temple of Time
Foggy ForestHome of an ancient tomb guarded by ghostly Keepers; its fog brings illusions and weak sight
Wild WastelandLair of the Fire Konung, whose strength comes from four Altars of War
Vault of True KnowledgeKinet archive with documents from the Beginning of Time
Sacred ForestVital forest, which has grown and died eight times since the Lost City fell
Red MountainsChaot homeland, which gives its name to the Chaots' law
Wooden CageThe prison of trees where a legendary hero waits to be freed
Snowflake MazeIce labyrinth of the yearly Kinet tournament
BorderlandsWhere the lands of all four races meet; the road to new lands is said to begin there

Lands of the Vitals

PlaceWhat it is
Forest LandThe Vital country
Blackthorn FortressNorthern fortress of the Blackthorn clan, cut off by the Synthet invasion
Forbidden GroveSacred grove that only initiates may enter
Spring of LifeThe Vitals' holiest relic, on a lake island in the Forbidden Grove; Diamanda takes the Vital ether here
Golden Ash-Tree CityThe Vital capital, home of the dragon Musician and an ancient treant

Lands of the Chaots

PlaceWhat it is
Land of ChaosThe Chaot country
Fire ValleyKonnar's home
Chaos EyeThe holiest Chaot altar, in a volcano crater, guarded by the Great Shaman; Diamanda takes the ether of Chaos here
City of Thundering StonesChaot city taken by a Kinet night raid
Western and Eastern CastlesSeats of the two halves of the race
Main ArenaWhere the West and the East settle disputes with duels of monsters
Island FortressFortress fought over by Chaots and Kinets
Northern IslandThe Kinets' price for peace

Lands of the Kinets

PlaceWhat it is
Lands of MovementThe Kinet country
City of Eight GatesThe thousand-year-old Kinet capital, overrun by the Pale Plague
Market PlaceTrading district of the capital
Fish IslandWhere the Head of the Sixteen was caged
Temple of OrderIts priests find the rite that weakens the plague
Shrine of OrderKinet holy place that shields their lands from hostile magic
Northern PeninsulaOn the border with the Synthets; the White Lord's portal opens here

Lands of the Synthets

PlaceWhat it is
Land of SynthesisThe Synthet country
Axis CityThe Synthet capital, consumed by the Pale Rust
Shrine of SynthesisSynthet holy place that shields their lands from hostile magic
Abandoned CityWhere the White Lord's whirlwind devoured the souls of mighty heroes and opened the portal

See also the pages of the four races: Chaots, Kinets, Vitals and Synthets.
